description: Passes a random share of the sixteen channels of one polyphonic cable and silences the rest

params.text: Makes a fresh choice, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Moves the block of channels in play one channel towards the first
Moves the block of channels in play one channel towards the sixteenth
Sets the first channel of the block in play, 0 to 16
Sets the channel the block in play stops before, 0 to 16
Sets the share of the channels in the block that is passed, 0 for none and 1 for all
Sets the number the random choices are generated from, so that a reset replays the same sequence of choices
Reloads the seed, which makes the next choices repeat the run that followed the last reload
Picks what voltage range the two selection jacks are read over: 0-1v, 0-10v or 0-16v, spread across the sixteen channels

inputs.text: A rising edge here makes a fresh choice of which channels to pass
Sets the share of the block that is passed, 0V to 1V, and overrides the probability knob while patched; the red lamp lights if the voltage falls outside that range
Sets the first channel of the block, read over the range set by the scaling switch, and overrides the start knob while patched; the red lamp lights if the block would start out of range
Sets the channel the block stops before, read over the range set by the scaling switch, and overrides the end knob while patched; the red lamp lights if the block would end out of range
The polyphonic cable whose channels are passed or silenced
A rising edge here moves the block one channel towards the first
A rising edge here moves the block one channel towards the sixteenth
A rising edge here reloads the seed

outputs.text: Carries sixteen channels: the chosen ones carry their channel of the input and the rest carry 0V

notes: nothing moves until the trigger jack rises or the button is pressed, and the output is monophonic and silent until then
with nothing patched to the input the chosen channels carry 10V, which makes the module usable as a random gate source on its own
a monophonic cable at the input is copied to every chosen channel
the orange lamps show which channels are in the block and the green lamps which of them are passing

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:

a negative voltage does nothing here.
